title: Degreewise affine Hom complex comparison
statement: With the notation and hypotheses of lem-sc-affine-hom-complex-evaluation-d, for every complex I there is a chain isomorphism d as there, and in every degree n the component of d followed by precomposition and evaluation equals the component of the mapped adjunction counit.

source.place: Tags 0BUZ, 0BV0, and 0AX3, termwise affine Hom evaluation

proof.text: Apply the proved underived affine Hom comparison and counit equality. Derive the two needed additive instances from this isomorphism and the canonical unit-Hom isomorphism, then lift the affine comparison naturally to complexes.

Use natural single-source isomorphisms for the pushed-forward structure sheaf and the unit. Their compatibility with precomposition turns the canonical complex evaluation composite into the mapped underived counit; complex extensionality and its degreewise equation prove this equality.

Compare canonical evaluation e0 with the supplied e by the natural identity automorphism a=e0 inverse composed with e. Precompose the comparison with a inverse at its source. Naturality of a inverse with respect to the counit cancels a inverse and a, yielding the equality for e. Take the degree components of this chain-map equality. This categorical adjustment is proved by the private helper adjustComparison.
